components.title: Filter orders by date range
components.what: Select all orders with order_date from 2026-05-09 to 2026-06-14 inclusive, regardless of status.

components.title: Deduplicate and extract unit_price values
components.what: Remove exact duplicate rows (same order_id and all fields) so each such order counts once, then collect the unit_price field from each remaining order in the filtered set.

components.title: Compute median unit_price
components.what: Sort the unit_price values and calculate the median (average of the two middle values if count is even), rounding to two decimal places.
